title: Deftones’ ‘I Will Find You’ Synch Is No. 1 on Top TV Songs Chart
summary: "Change (In the House of Flies)" leads the June 2026 edition.
contentText:
The June 2026 edition of Billboard ‘s Top TV Songs chart, powered by Tunefind (a Songtradr company), is chock full of music from the newly premiered Every Year After as well as the eighth season of The Chi .

But it’s Netflix newcomer I Will Find You that takes the top spot, thanks to a synch of Deftones’ “Change (In the House of Flies).”

Rankings for the Top TV Songs chart are based on song and show data provided by Tunefind and ranked using a formula blending that data with sales and streaming information tracked by Luminate during the corresponding period of June 2026.

“Change” can be heard in the second episode of the miniseries, the entirety of which premiered on Netflix on June 18.

A No. 3 hit for Deftones on Billboard ‘s Alternative Airplay chart in 2000 (then marking the band’s first top 10 on any songs ranking), “Change” earned 13.8 million official on-demand streams and sold 1,000 downloads in the United States in June 2026, according to Luminate, in addition to interaction on the Tunefind website.

Otherwise, Every Year After holds the largest share of the June 2026 Top TV Songs chart, with five of the 10 positions occupied by the newly released Prime Video series.

Weezer’s “Island in the Sun,” which reached No. 11 on Alternative Airplay a year after Deftones, leads the group at No. 2, with the rest of the rundown including a pair of songs from Billie Eilish, plus music from sombr and Demi Lovato.

See the full top 10, also featuring music from The Chi and Dutton Ranch , below.
